messages.author: Nicolas Feldman
messages.body:
>I'm writing you because I have some issues during my installation of amber in windows 10 via the ubuntu command line. I'm kind of lost with some of the guidance because I do not have a very strong programming  skills and some of the error that I'm having are because when I solved something a new error come up. There is a way to solve problems like error when installing miniconda  or it would be better to do it via a virtualBox rather than through this ubuntu in windows 10.
When I install ./configure gnu I got the error when installing miniconda and when I chage as I read to the last version of miniconda manually error messeage because of a pathc error or something similar. Coul you hel pleas.
Kind regards
